title: VerifiableCredential
description: A W3C Verifiable Credential — a tamper-evident, cryptographically-signed claim made by an issuer about a subject.

@context.description: JSON-LD context. VC requires the credentials v1 or v2 context to be present.

@id.description: The Credential's identifier — often a UUID or HTTPS URL.

@type.description: Must include VerifiableCredential, optionally plus a more specific subtype.

issuer.description: The party that issued the credential. Either an IRI or an Object with @id and optional metadata.

issuanceDate.description: When the credential was issued (ISO 8601). VC 1.x.

validFrom.description: When the credential becomes valid (ISO 8601). VC 2.0 alternative to issuanceDate.

validUntil.description: When the credential ceases to be valid (ISO 8601). VC 2.0 alternative to expirationDate.

credentialSubject.description: The entity the credential makes claims about. Object (one subject) or array (many subjects). Each carries @id and arbitrary claim properties.

credentialStatus.description: Reference to a status mechanism (revocation list, status list).

proof.description: Cryptographic proof — issuer signature. Object (one proof) or array (multiple proofs).
